PARENTS per the 1911 census: William Larkin (M0003) & Ellen née McAlone (M0001). Siblings in the household: William (~15), Mary Ann (~14), Hugh (~11), Ellen (~4 — the direct ancestor).

FATE RESOLVED (research 2026-07-03, ~95% confidence): STAYED IN ENGLAND. Died Jun quarter 1973, Whitehaven district (GRO 1A/422), aged 70, with the index's exact d.o.b. 28 Feb 1903. Identification: the ONLY Samuel Larkin born in England & Wales 1902-1904 is his Whitehaven registration; no child/youth death exists 1903-1921 anywhere in E&W; every other adult death entry 1921-1992 fails on age or DOB; and he died in the same small district where he was born. Residual caveat: an identically-born Irish namesake dying there cannot be fully excluded without the death certificate.
APPARENTLY NEVER MARRIED: no Samuel Larkin marriage in Cumberland 1921-1973, and the three England-wide candidates are other regions' Larkin families — so likely no descendants.

Human touch: when 14-year-old Ellen emigrated alone in May 1921 (their father had died in Maine in 1920), Samuel was 18 and stayed — possibly the reason the Whitehaven household could dissolve. Brother and sister then lived out their lives an ocean apart: he died in Whitehaven in 1973, she in Brockton in 1995.
